content.text: The plan checks and workspace displays read the organization repository’s plan value, which still comes from the stale workspace record. I’ll make that repository return the subscription’s plan when present, with the workspace plan as a fallback. The trial sweep also needs to filter for `trialing` status.

input.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import { toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";', 'import { toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";\\nimport { findSubscription } from \"./subscription-repository\";')
s=s.replace('return row ? toOrganization(row) : null;', 'return row ? withCurrentPlan(toOrganization(row)) : null;')
s=s.replace('return rows.map((row) => toOrganization(row.org));', 'return Promise.all(rows.map((row) => withCurrentPlan(toOrganization(row.org))));')
s=s.replace('return toOrganization(row);', 'return withCurrentPlan(toOrganization(row));')
s += '''
/** Resolve on every read so existing stale workspace records need no repair. */
async function withCurrentPlan(org: Organization): Promise<Organization> {
  const subscription = await findSubscription(org.id);
  return subscription ? { ...org, plan: subscription.plan } : org;
}
'''
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import { and, isNotNull, lte, ne }', 'import { and, eq, isNotNull, lte, ne }')
s=s.replace(' * Every paid subscription starts life as a trial whose first period is the\\n * trial window, so \"a paid plan whose period has run out\" is the whole test.', ' * Only subscriptions still trialing are eligible; choosing a plan ends the\\n * trial even when the original trial period end remains in the past.')
s=s.replace('        isNotNull(subscriptions.currentPeriodEnd),', '        eq(subscriptions.status, \"trialing\"),\\n        isNotNull(subscriptions.currentPeriodEnd),')
p.write_text(s)
PY"
